description: Ingestion set: Malaysian law PDFs selected for reference use by the Haze Agent. This is a filtered subset of the full archive register.

disclaimer.not_legal_advice: Nothing here is advice, an opinion, or a conclusion about what the law means or requires.
disclaimer.not_official_text: Website downloads, not Gazette copies printed by the Government Printer. See Interpretation Acts 1948 and 1967 (Act 388) s.61.
disclaimer.check_the_date: Every document carries law_as_at. Act 127 is as at 1 January 2006 and is stale.
disclaimer.not_complete: 4 documents only. Other laws and guidance that apply to open burning are not included.

selection_rule: Include a document only if the agent will cite it or apply a rule from it. Governance/sourcing Acts and off-domain Acts are excluded.

ingest_role.core_operating_rule: The operative subsidiary rule the agent applies.
ingest_role.parent_act: The parent Act the rule is made under.
ingest_role.amending_act: Amendment that updates the parent Act.
ingest_role.definitional_dependency: Included only so a term used by the core rule can be resolved.

field_notes.sha256_original: SHA-256 of the file as downloaded, before the provenance page was appended. Printed on the last page of each PDF.
field_notes.sha256_file: SHA-256 of the file on disk now, provenance page included.
field_notes.law_as_at: Revision date of the text in the file. Cite with this date.

integrity_note: The sha256_file values here were re-hashed from the copies in this folder and match the source_manifest. Byte identity with the remote file is NOT established for any entry.

documents.law_as_at: Made under s.29AA(1) EQA 1974; in force 1 January 2004
documents.notes: The operative open-burning rule. Source is FAOLEX (UN FAO), not the AGC portal; no AGC static link found.
Stale text: as at 2006 and superseded by A1712 (2024) and A1793 (2026). Read with those amendments, or replace with a consolidated reprint.

documents.law_as_at: Royal assent 27 May 2024; gazetted 6 June 2024; in force 7 July 2024
documents.notes: Inserts the open burning definition; raises the s.29A/29AA penalties.
Optional. Referred to by the Open Burning Order 2003 for the Fire Officer definitions; include only if Order terms must resolve.

excluded_from_ingest.notes: Excluded documents remain in law_agent/sources/pdf/ and stay registered in the source_manifest. Governance Acts must never be loaded as retrievable content.
